astronauts.name: Mika Tanaka
astronauts.$story: mood dip 3 days, homesick, menu fatigue

astronauts.name: Leo Martins
astronauts.$story: stressed, poor sleep, knee strain, fitness near 10% loss (alert)

data.description: Hit my hand on a cargo bag latch while moving supplies.
Twisted my knee getting off the treadmill harness.

messages.author: orbi
messages.text: Good morning, Ana. How did you sleep?

messages.author: astronaut
messages.text: Not great. Woke up twice and felt tired all morning.

messages.author: orbi
messages.text: Your wrist band shows 5h 20m and low light exposure in the evening. That often shifts sleep on station.

messages.author: orbi
messages.text: Want me to set a 21:00 wind-down and dim the cabin lights?

messages.author: astronaut
messages.text: Missed talking to my family today. Everything tastes the same.

journal.summary: Long lab shift, but felt in control. Slept badly, woke twice.
Productive day in the station. Felt more focused.

alerts.text: Low light exposure before sleep, 3 short nights.
Mood dip 3 days in a row.
Same lunch 4 days, taste ratings dropping.
Sleep below 5h for 3 nights and high stress.

ground_messages.text: Hi Ana, your logs show short sleep 3 nights in a row. We moved cabin lights to dim at 21:00 for the crew.
Thanks! The fan in the sleep quarters is loud, my band logged 52 dB.
Maintenance will check that fan tomorrow. Keep logging sleep so we can compare.
Can I book a family video call on Thursday evening?
Leo, please rest the knee today and skip the treadmill. Check-up at 15:00.
